question: What is the first name of the only Malko Competition recipient from the 20th Century (after 1977) whose nationality on record is a country that no longer exists?

history.name: Assistant
history.content: Decision: For the "nationality on record," we will privilege the official competition website for post-1977 entries (as the authoritative record). Under this approach, the only 20th-century recipient with a dissolved-country nationality is from 1974: Gotthard Lienicke.
